'''Zem''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who ran a small shop in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Olaris]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zem was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears on the Republic version of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Taris, as a Specialty Goods vendor in Olaris.<ref name="TOR" />
